ChordMini / BTC chord classifier

The Transpose network-only classifier was extracted from the received
ChordMini/BTC audio estimator with SHA-256
de9bf15843417c9d1f194dadb1ef08c80838273dc689ecdfbe02d7900794e16f.
The distributed classifier has SHA-256
1e6a1329f643d38427cf13f04f2361eba10cf988ef4f74d8fa841ef5a562de1d.

ChordMini project and weights:
https://github.com/ptnghia-j/ChordMini
